sameDayRetelling: Heir 2 Fenn Ash ran with the retreat rule I'd taken from heir 1's death screen. He finally beat the Foundry Master ('HP 37% → retreat ×15', then a heal), broke into the Deep and pushed past his father's record to D28. There my retreat rule had 'no path ← foes on every side' against a ring of lurkers, and Thar the lurker killed him at 1 hp, so the next heir went out with a grudge to settle.
blindness: No violations of content. Read only RATING.md, FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, FRAMEWORK §1–3, template, presets idle-hybrid weights, and the driver/drive.sh usage header (infrastructure). An `ls eval/cards/3ab97ea*` showed the filename of another rater's card; its contents were not opened.

axes.note: Death screens name cause, trace and fixes ('drink heal at 45% under retreat at 50%'), and the forecast shows deltas ('death 13→50%'). But several numbers didn't reconcile: 'bad luck · 1 in 6' on a 48→0-in-10s King death, 'survives 11/12 … death 56→89%', '47/44 hp', and a report face that said only 'hurt · went home' when the cause was 'return at 25% · 14/57'.

Real forecast trade-offs: return hp<30%→10% gave 'D32 25→63% · death 13→50%', and I took the King gamble and would again. Lapse: 'compare outcomes' read 'close' for almost every tactic, and forge/legacy buys were mostly strictly ordered.

Within the hour I learned to read shadowing ('0/390 fires', 'under retreat at 50%') and that the D28 wall was heal supply, not rules. Heir resets and repeated early floors kept the curve flat after that.
The King push was a stake I chose ('King 50%±35 · death 50%') and watched resolve live. But most of every watched run is a foregone D1–D23 replay ('WARLORD BREAKS … BLOAT MOTHER DOWN').

Hand control answered each 'attack' tap with a hit line within ~1 s, and boss plaques ('MIRROR KING · COUNTER: MIRROR RHYTHM') land well. Dead stretches of 25–56 s at default speed under summary chips ('travel 78%') work against it. Audio unassessed.
Each band changed my play (Foundry 'REFLECTED!', Queen 'READ SILENCE', King mirrors), as did grudges and 'Freed the captive. It followed.'. Once seen, the same openings repeat every run.

'Guarded slayer' plus my own 'on see captive → free captive' felt mine, and the chip changed to 'freed captive'. Most of the build is pre-written packages, and the report said 'picked 27% · chores 72%'.

Grudges carried across heirs: 'grudge: Thar the lurker' → 'Hale Ash → Thar … fell' → 'avenged Thar'. A freed captive fought for my hero. Lapse: the reel lines repeat ('Cut the captive down. No one weeps.' many times).
Check-ins took 2–5 min and ended on a send. Absences felt distinct (20m: 1 run; 8h: 4 runs and a named stall). In-run there are 25–56 s idle stretches, and D1–D23 replays every run.

Every death gave cause, trace, last-fight dps and replayed fixes ('hp < 50% · foes ≥ 2 → retreat · survives 12/12 · was 2/12'). Next run is one tap. Lapse: the 'bad luck 1 in 6' framing and a contradictory 'all harm' fix list.
Weight 0 in idle-hybrid. Named heirs and grudges only.
I chose goals the game didn't ask for (free captives, flee the King). Route and order are fixed by the dungeon.

$0→$12604, D3→D33, a town that fills in, workers taking over chores ('porter · hauled $6467', 'scout · sent 4'), rule slots 4→5, tactics to L5. Lapse: the legacy tree completed in about an hour, and each heir resets XP so the forecast dips ('D29 25%→<15%').
Torch-lit cave over a growing village, an orange Foundry, the tattered 'YOU DIED' banner. Lapse: dark dungeon floors read muddy at phone size. Audio unassessed.

The 8h return named a stall ('none beyond floor 28') with a pick-one and a suggestion. The 20m return was '1 RUNS · $0 GOLD EARNED' and a death, and the suggestion I took led into the King's mirror ('DEALT 0 dps').

I could say whose rule did it: 'retreat at 50% 89%' killed heir 3 (my applied fix), and my 10% return saved the last King run ('RETURN', 'returned $2542'). Lapse: the report credits 'chores 68–73%' to most decisions, and package rows I never wrote ('return at 25%') ended several runs.
